from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EpsRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company associated with this EPS data")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this EPS figure")
    metric_label: str = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g. 'Basic loss per share')")
    basic_eps_value: float = Field(description="The Basic EPS amount; losses should be negative values")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the financial statement containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EpsRecord]
